title: Bluetooth RFID Ear Tag Reader
description: Bluetooth LF RFID scanner for animal ear tag reading and livestock identification, with portable data capture for breeding and farm management.
summary: This Bluetooth RFID scanner is designed for portable low-frequency ear tag reading in livestock operations, helping farms capture and transfer animal identification data in the field.
Easy to hold and scan the RFID ear tags.
The bluetooth RFID scanner can transmit the data to other device with bluetooth conveniently.

faq.question: What is Bluetooth RFID Ear Tag Reader commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for livestock, breeding, and animal identification workflows that need portable low-frequency tag reading with Bluetooth data transfer.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Bluetooth RFID Ear Tag Reader?
faq.answer: Protocol: ISO Standards 11784 and 11785, with FDX-B capability Frequency: 134Khz
